ideas.title: Market Loom
ideas.mechanism: Opt-in executed swaps apply signed, bounded rewrite rules to a shared persistent cellular world; collective paths open nonfinancial capabilities for all visitors.
ideas.novelty: Trades compose lasting transformations and unlock executable world rules, rather than producing independent Arena waves or a cosmetic chart.
ideas.rationale: A market can become a public instrument people learn to play together, without rewarding volume or manufacturing yield.
constraints: Existing fees and allocations unchanged
No prize, token issuance or balance transfer
Authenticated user intent, not router sender or tx.origin
Bounded constant-time automaton; finalized replay
Primarily external app in first version
openQuestions: Does collective authorship attract repeat nontrading visitors?
Can signed hookData be safely supported by real routers?
Does shared onchain state justify its gas cost over public log replay?

ideas.title: Commons Crossing
ideas.mechanism: Optional signed traders submit complementary buy/sell intents to a bounded epoch auction; sponsor-funded execution activates only if a two-sided participation threshold and every signed limit are satisfied. The smallest version executes each order through the existing main pool and grants a shared nonfinancial unlock.
ideas.novelty: A collective assurance condition coordinates multiple willing trades and shared consequences; it is not a standing limit order, lottery or per-trade discount.
ideas.rationale: Test whether traders prefer making a move together and reducing unilateral exposure rather than acting alone.
constraints: Never force a trade or trap selling
No assumed LP revenue or cross-pool arbitrage profit
Existing main-pool fees apply to each executed swap
Bounded order count, refunds, deadline, explicit custody
External auction/router dominates implementation
openQuestions: Can sequential pool execution satisfy all limits without privileged ordering?
Do thresholds reduce failures or simply delay execution?
Can crossing later be priced transparently without undermining project funding?

ideas.title: Liquidity Creature
ideas.mechanism: A separately funded same-token experimental pool moves sponsor-owned liquidity among a small set of habitats according to a persistent, bounded memory of actual price traversal; trades change future executable depth.
ideas.novelty: The market has path-dependent inventory behavior and a collective ecology, not a visual pet or an ordinary LP optimizer.
ideas.rationale: Explore whether a market with memory creates understandable cooperative and adversarial play while preserving free exits.
constraints: Separate PoolKey and explicitly funded liquidity
Only sponsor principal moves; no existing LP principal used
No guaranteed liquidity or LP fee revenue
Hard inventory and rate bounds; swaps never wait for keeper
No second project token, confiscation or selling gate
openQuestions: Can any transition improve discovery or execution after adverse selection and gas?
How easily can a trader farm predictable rebalance inventory?
What minimum funded depth makes the experiment useful?

ideas.title: Trade Archaeology
ideas.mechanism: An opt-in swap commits a public experiment hypothesis hash; an independently checked later observation resolves a permanent museum record comparing intention with outcome, without a wager.
ideas.novelty: A falsifiable participant prediction is bound to an actual settled action and public evidence, rather than a generic paid report.
ideas.rationale: Could teach market behavior and build a reusable dataset.
constraints: No outcome payout
Participant labels remain untrusted
No private trader profiling
openQuestions: Would it be more than a journal app?
Which hypotheses have objective, reproducible definitions?
ideas.deferralReason: Useful evidence tooling, but weaker dependence on programmable market state than shortlisted concepts; revisit with a specific reproducible experiment.

ideas.title: Counterfactual Reserve
ideas.mechanism: Publish paired fixed-budget shadow strategies driven by the same actual swap history; only a separately funded tiny pilot executes the winning hypothesis after preregistered evaluation.
ideas.novelty: A controlled live-versus-shadow intervention measures causal inventory costs, not an AI trading dashboard.
ideas.rationale: Could prevent claiming profit from price marks or internal transfers.
constraints: Shadow results cannot establish executable yield
No LP principal budget
Out-of-sample evaluation required
openQuestions: Can the pilot alter its own measurement?

ideas.title: Gap Commons
ideas.mechanism: Same-token separately funded second pool auctions the right to close an independently measured gap and escrows only realized surplus for public experiments.
ideas.novelty: Transparent competitive surplus allocation, rather than claiming WTH profit sharing as a new invention.
ideas.rationale: A possible funding experiment if genuine third-party flow exists.
constraints: Second pool needs new ETH and CLAUS capital
Main pool LP fee is zero
Subtract gas, project/platform fees, adverse selection and capital loss
Never create volume to claim profit
openQuestions: Is organic gap flow sufficient after all costs?
Can auction winners settle without callback recursion?
ideas.deferralReason: WTH already advertises closely related capture. No verified net-margin data or seed budget; revisit only with measured organic opportunities and materially different allocation rules.

ideas.title: Market Metronome
ideas.mechanism: Signed opt-in trades commit notes into a deterministic score whose collective rhythm changes the next epoch composition grammar.
ideas.novelty: Persistent compositional grammar is more than sonifying a price chart.
ideas.rationale: A playful public performance could involve nonholders.
constraints: No prizes or volume incentives
No copyright source reuse assumed
Bounded events and replay
openQuestions: Does musical structure create behavior distinct from Market Loom?
ideas.deferralReason: Currently shares the Loom transition mechanism; retain as an interface experiment, not inflate the shortlist with a reskin.
